question: What is the biggest monthly consumption of the customers who use euro as their currency?
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching yearmonth record.
gold: SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / 12 AS MonthlyConsumption FROM customers AS T1 LEFT JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Currency = 'EUR' GROUP BY T1.CustomerID ORDER BY MonthlyConsumption DESC LIMIT 1
gold0: SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / 12 AS MonthlyConsumption FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Currency = 'EUR' GROUP BY T1.CustomerID ORDER BY MonthlyConsumption DESC LIMIT 1

b.request: Find the largest per-customer monthly consumption (SUM of Consumption divided by 12, over each customer's yearmonth records) among customers whose Currency is 'EUR', using a left join from customers to yearmonth so that euro customers with no matching yearmonth record are also kept (treated as having null/zero consumption)
b.sql: SELECT MAX(monthly) AS max_monthly_consumption FROM (SELECT c.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) / 12.0 AS monthly FROM customers c LEFT JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' GROUP BY c.CustomerID)

c.request:
What is the biggest monthly consumption of the customers who use euro as their currency?
Evidence: Monthly consumption = SUM(consumption) / 12
Also keep rows that have no matching yearmonth record.
c.sql: SELECT MAX(m) AS biggest_monthly_consumption FROM (SELECT c.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) / 12.0 AS m FROM customers c LEFT JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' GROUP BY c.CustomerID)
